capabilities: Toggle <u> tags on the current selection or insert empty tags
Remove underline formatting by re-running the command on underlined text
Wrap text in <center> tags from the command palette
Insert links to headings or blocks
Assign a custom hotkey for the underline command
extras: The README points users to the author's separate Text Format plugin for custom prefix/suffix wrappers; the demo section references an image not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in underline command or shortcut for wrapping text in <u> tags.

relations.evidence: it is recommended to install my another plugin "Text Format"

summary: Command-based formatting tool that toggles <u> underline tags on selections via hotkey, plus commands for <center> and heading/block links.
